translations.web: in which were all kinds of four-footed animals of the earth, wild animals, reptiles, and birds of the sky.
translations.bsb: It contained all kinds of four-footed animals and reptiles of the earth, as well as birds of the air.
translations.kjv: Wherein were all manner of fourfooted beasts of the earth, and wild beasts, and creeping things, and fowls of the air.
translations.asv: wherein were all manner of fourfooted beasts and creeping things of the earth and birds of the heaven.
